system.name: HILOS
system.one_liner: a near-storage-processing framework that boosts offline LLM inference throughput by offloading attention to SmartSSD accelerators

components.name: Host
components.role: issues attention requests and Q vectors, receives the final attention result

components.name: NSP Device (e.g., SmartSSD)
components.role: near-storage processing device housing the SSD, DRAM and attention accelerator

components.name: SSD
components.role: storage media inside the near-storage device

components.name: Internal PCI Switch
components.role: internal interconnect linking SSD, DRAM and the accelerator inside the device

components.name: DRAM
components.role: near-storage DRAM buffer for K, Q, QK^T and attention scores

components.name: Query-Key Product Unit
components.role: computes QK^T using an in-place local block transpose to avoid a global Key-matrix transpose

components.name: Softmax Statistics Aggregation Unit
components.role: first pass of the two-pass softmax: streams input blocks through a max-reduction tree and adder tree to compute local max and partial sum

components.name: Softmax Normalization Unit
components.role: second pass of the two-pass softmax: performs element-wise exponential and division using the global max/sum to produce the attention score

components.name: Score-Value Product Unit
components.role: computes the attention score times Value product to produce the attention result

components.name: Q-Buf / K-Buf / K^T-Buf
components.role: on-chip buffers holding the query block, the loaded key block, and its locally transposed version

components.name: V-Buf
components.role: on-chip buffer holding the value block for the score-value product

flows.what: Q, K and control commands via the internal PCI switch

content.key_idea: A temporal, block-based (e.g. 128-token) attention accelerator inside a SmartSSD pipelines four concurrent hardware units -- query-key product with in-place local transpose, a two-pass streaming softmax split into statistics-aggregation and normalization units, and a score-value product -- to keep on-chip memory small for long sequences.
content.reading_order: Panel (a) at top shows the overall block-pipelined dataflow across the four hardware units inside the NSP device; panels (b)-(e) below zoom into each unit's internal buffer/MAC datapath in turn.

summary: HILOS is a near-storage-processing framework that boosts offline LLM inference throughput by offloading memory-intensive attention computation onto SmartSSD accelerators. This figure details the dataflow and microarchitecture of that attention accelerator across five panels. Panel (a) shows the overall block-pipelined dataflow inside the NSP device: a Query-Key Product Unit, a Softmax Statistics Aggregation Unit, a Softmax Normalization Unit and a Score-Value Product Unit form a concurrent pipeline over the SSD/DRAM/PCI-switch fabric, processing fixed-size token blocks (e.g. 128 tokens) to bound on-chip memory. Panels (b) and (c) zoom into the two-pass streaming softmax: the statistics-aggregation unit computes a local max and partial sum via reduction/adder trees with a streaming update, and the normalization unit applies exponentiation and division using the resulting global max/sum. Panels (d) and (e) zoom into the query-key product unit's in-place local block-transpose datapath (Q-Buf/K-Buf/K^T-Buf) and the score-value product unit's MAC datapath, respectively.
summary_zh: 该图展示HILOS近存储注意力加速器的数据流与微架构：(a) 查询-键乘法单元、两遍流式Softmax的统计聚合与归一化单元、分数-值乘法单元构成分块并发流水线；(b)(c)详细展示两遍Softmax的最大值/求和与指数除法；(d)(e)展示原地局部转置与分数-值乘法的缓冲/乘加数据通路。
